Ghost Trap.name: Ghost Trap
Ghost Trap.summary: Ghost Trap is an Action Adventure game, developed by Artoon and published by Eidos Interactive, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Super Robot Taisen A.name: Super Robot Taisen A
Super Robot Taisen A.summary: Super Robot Taisen A (Advance) is the first Super Robot Wars on the Game Boy Advance. The Londo Bell forces battle against the Shadow Mirror.
